event.name: NFL Season Kickoff
event.title: NFL Kickoff 2026 Countdown: How Many Days Until Football Is Back?
event.desc: Live countdown to the 2026 NFL season kickoff, a Super Bowl LX rematch between the Seahawks and Patriots.
event.intro: Football returns with the NFL Kickoff Game on Wednesday night, September 9, 2026, a Super Bowl LX rematch as the Seattle Seahawks host the New England Patriots. Since 2004 the season has opened at the home of the defending Super Bowl champion; this is only the second time the opener has fallen on a Wednesday. This countdown ticks to kickoff.

sections.p: The NFL created the standalone Thursday opener in 2002 (a concert-and-football spectacle in Times Square) and made it the champion's showcase in 2004. The 2026 opener shifts to Wednesday, September 9 — only the second time in league history the Kickoff Game hasn't fallen on a Thursday, after a similar 2012 shift around the Democratic National Convention.

The Kickoff Game has gone to the reigning champion for two straight seasons. In 2025 the Philadelphia Eagles, fresh off Super Bowl LIX, beat the Dallas Cowboys 24-20 at Lincoln Financial Field on September 4 — a game delayed 65 minutes by lightning, and decided by Jalen Hurts and Saquon Barkley in a back-and-forth second half.

The NFL plays the fewest games of any major league, so its fans wait the longest — about seven months from the Super Bowl to kickoff. That scarcity is exactly why this one night out-rates almost everything else on TV all year.

records.label: Highest-scoring Kickoff Game
records.value: 76 combined points, tied twice — Denver 49, Baltimore 27 (2013) and Green Bay 42, New Orleans 34 (2011)

records.label: Most passing yards in a Kickoff Game
records.value: Peyton Manning — 462 yards, 7 TDs, no interceptions, for Denver in 2013

records.label: Most Kickoff Game appearances
records.value: New England and Kansas City, 4 each, both 3-1

records.label: Home teams usually win the opener
records.value: The home team has won all but 6 Kickoff Games since 2002

howToWatch.text: The NFL Kickoff Game airs nationally on NBC and streams on Peacock as part of NBC's Sunday Night Football franchise, which has held the rights since 2006. The game usually opens the season on the Thursday before Week 1, though the date isn't fixed year to year — it shifted to a Wednesday in 2012, and again for the 2026 opener.
